name: one-sdd
description: Battle-tested Codex workflows — curated One SDD skills + SDD pipeline, production-ready MCP configs, and selective-install-aligned conventions for TDD, security scanning, code review, and spec-driven development.

interface.shortDescription: Curated One SDD skills + Spec Driven Development pipeline plus MCP configs for TDD, security, code review.
interface.longDescription: One SDD is a focused plugin for general software development with Java / Python / JavaScript / TypeScript. It bundles a Spec Driven Development pipeline (specify → clarify → design → tasks → implement → verify), TDD workflow, security scanning, code review, architecture decisions, and verification loops — all in one installable plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use the sdd-workflow skill to drive feature work via spec → clarify → design → tasks → implement → verify.
Use speckit-* skills (under ./skills/) for the GitHub Spec Kit lane with .specify/ when that workflow is active.
Use the tdd-workflow skill to write tests before implementation.
Use the security-review skill to scan for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
Use the verification-loop skill to verify correctness before shipping changes.
